def: to mount up; hence, in general, to rise, (figuratively) be majestic
kjv: gloriously, grow up, increase, be risen, triumph.

occurrences.text: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the Lord, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?
For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.
Afterward he measured a thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.
